title: S2-008 acceptance campaign, paid leg: a model-calling executor under the same frozen rule
description: One model predictor and two carried control predictors in the original three-comparison family. The model replaces trial 01; the metric, baseline, band, three seeds, stopping rule and one-shot holdout policy stay frozen.

proposed_relation.subject: the commit message subject line
proposed_relation.object: whether the commit is MAJOR, on the newest 25% of the real Veritas history

confounders.description: the base rate of MAJOR commits is low in the dev partition, so a predictor biased towards MAJOR loses agreement to the majority class; a difference in base rate between the two partitions would move every arm at once
the partitions are not exchangeable: dev ends 2026-09-26 and the holdout is the following days, during which the ticket itself was under active work

alternative_explanations.description: the arms differ only in how often they predict the rare class, and no arm carries information about the message beyond that frequency
the dev-partition base rate is an artefact of this checkout's squashed history rather than a property of the project

scope.population: every commit reachable from the acceptance base of the local Veritas checkout
domain_limits: this one repository and this one checkout; no other project and no other history was measured
the label is a path-prefix rule, not a judgement of importance: a MAJOR commit that only edits a README is labelled MINOR
association only; no causal effect of message wording on change size is claimed and none is measurable here

assumptions: the holdout partition is a temporal successor of the dev partition and the base rate did not move materially between them
the predictor is a pure function of the subject line, so it cannot have seen the diff it is predicting

falsifiers.description: the dev-partition base rate of MAJOR commits is 0 or 1, so the majority-class baseline is perfect and no arm can beat it
the label is not a function of the tree alone
falsifiers.observable: re-labelling every dev commit under a constant subject returns a different label vector

falsifiers.description: the preregistered rule cannot reject anything, so the campaign is undecidable by construction

card.test_design: One preregistered trial per arm (family of 3, Holm-Bonferroni at alpha 0.05, confidence 0.9833333333333333 derived as 1 - alpha/m). Each trial measures case_agreement_rate of the arm's prediction against the message-independent MAJOR label over the temporal holdout partition, opened exactly once through the sealed one-shot unseal, with 3 frozen bootstrap seeds whose intervals are HULLED (widest) so no seed is ever selected. Observational corpus; inference_mode ASSOCIATIONAL.

frozen_baseline.computed_from: the 376 dev commits; the holdout was not read

seed_rule.disclosure: every seed is reported with its own interval; no seed is ranked, selected or dropped

bootstrap_process.where: a second isolated launch, after the decision point, never predicting anything
bootstrap_process.why_separate: a bootstrap needs the agreement vector, which is a function of the label; the predictor must never see a label, so the two cannot be one process
bootstrap_process.multiplicity: every resample is carried as its full per-case multiplicity vector, so a case drawn three times counts three times and the resample mean converges on the measured rate
bootstrap_process.guard: a trial whose resample mean does not sit at its own measured rate is refused, not published

budget_reservation.unit_definition: tokens, measured by the executor itself: pi --mode json reports usage.totalTokens on turn_end, and the arm reads that and nothing else. The mid-stream message_update events report zeros and are ignored, and a per-message report is not a run total, so the arm refuses rather than counting one. The model has no other spend channel: parallelism is 1 and the only egress destination the profile admits is open.bigmodel.cn:443.

usd_reference.measured: pi --mode json turn_end.usage.cost.total — the provider's own report

per_call_observed.note: one trivial call; the system prompt alone is about 9058 input tokens

usd_reference.why_it_is_here: the repository has no cost model of its own — policy.mjs carries task/campaign/day limits with a currency field and adapters.mjs:907 forbids inventing one — so this is a MEASURED reference and not a budget. The ceiling above is denominated in tokens because tokens is the unit the owner set the cap in.
usd_reference.caveat: The 5,000,000-token ceiling is about 29% above the measured 3,865,734-token plan. It is a binding control: stop before the next call when the recorded token total reaches the ceiling; report a budget stop rather than silently extending the campaign.

budget_reservation.enumerated_work: 1 model trial x 3 frozen seeds = 3 model runs x 126 holdout cases = 378 case calls; 2 regex control trials make no model calls

band_derivation.rule: noise_band = the Wilson-scaled half-width of the preregistered interval at the preregistered confidence for the preregistered holdout n, evaluated at the DEV-partition baseline
band_derivation.why: a difference below the width this design can resolve is not an effect this campaign is able to see; calling it one would be noise dressed as a finding

source_pin.rule: the corpus is a function of this commit and never of HEAD, so the data are the same bytes on any host and after any later commit

trial_list.predictor: the installed executor classifies the commit subject as MAJOR or MINOR — one word, one call per case
predict MAJOR iff the subject type is feat or fix
predict MINOR iff the subject type is chore, else predict MAJOR

recorded_before_first_trial.proof: no trial has run under this document, and the arm refuses an unapproved preregistration

source.kind: real repository history, read from the local checkout with git
source.label_rule: MAJOR iff the commit diff touches >= 1 path under src/lib/, contracts/ or migrations/; the rule never reads the commit message
source.split_rule: temporal: the oldest 75% of `git log --reverse <pinned_commit>` is the dev partition (PRIMARY), the newest 25% is the holdout (HOLDOUT)

arms.predictor: the installed executor classifies the commit subject as MAJOR or MINOR — one word, one call per case
predict MAJOR iff the subject type is feat or fix
predict MINOR iff the subject type is chore, else predict MAJOR

executor.credential_delivery: podman --env-file — a path on the host argv; neither the value nor the variable name is in any argv
executor.inside_isolation: LOCAL_RESTRICTED, digest-pinned, egress allowlist open.bigmodel.cn:443 only
executor.determinism_note: a model is not a function of its input. The arm records the digest of every raw answer so a repeat can be COMPARED against the committed one. No claim is made that the model is reproducible; the run statement is about the frozen inputs and the recorded outputs.
executor.unparseable_policy: an answer that is not exactly one of MAJOR/MINOR is UNPARSED and counts as a disagreement, never as a guess

model_image.field_why: this is a commitment to the CONTENT the run executes (arm, bridge, canonical-json, corpus, base, pi, recipe), not to the built image digest
model_image.cycle_why: the signed body is COPYed into this image, so a body carrying the image digest would contain a digest of itself; the direction is preregistration -> image only
model_image.built_image_pin_reason: the built image includes this signed document, so its digest is recorded in evidence and re-verified per launch; the signed body contains only the acyclic content commitment

supersession.reason: the model image gained the egress bridge, so its content commitment changed. The question, card, metric, baseline, band, seeds, family, stopping, holdout access, trial list and ceiling are unchanged.

approval.label: Daniil (repository owner)
approval.signed_digest_over: the scientific body: every member except approval, status and preregistration_digest
approval.becomes_in_force_when: scripts/s2-008-campaign-prepare.mjs --seal-v4 records this digest in the corpus manifest and carries a content-only SUPERSESSION from xpr-s2-008c-03
